prompt: Sanitize a batch of log files in the current directory. Remove any passwords, API tokens, bearer tokens, session IDs, and obvious secret-like values while preserving the original structure, timestamps, log levels, and non-sensitive text. Write the cleaned result to sanitized.log and also produce a short report named sanitize-report.txt listing how many redactions were made per input file. Process every .log file in the workspace except already sanitized outputs. Keep the output human-readable and deterministic.
